mapper.select: SELECT T.CURRENCY_CODE, T.EXCHANGE_RATE FROM V_MRM_SPOT_RATE T where T.DATA_DATE = #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME,T.CURRENCY_PAIR AS HEDGING_SET, '外汇掉期' AS TRADE_TYPE,T.BUY_OR_SELL AS POSITION,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE,T.FWD_SETTLE_DATE AS END_DATE, T.UNDERLYING_CURRENCY_CODE,T.UNDERLYING_CURRENCY_NOTIONAL_FWD,T.BASE_CURRENCY_CODE, T.BASE_CURRENCY_NOTIONAL_FWD,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM, 'CNY' AS MTM_CCY, NULL AS STRIKE_PRICE, NULL AS UNDERLYING_PRICE,T2.MA_ID FROM TB_13_FX_SWAP_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T2 ON T2.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.FWD_SETTLE_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME,T.CURRENCY_PAIR AS HEDGING_SET, '外汇期权' AS TRADE_TYPE,T.BUY_OR_SELL AS POSITION,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE,T.SETTLE_DATE AS END_DATE, T.CALL_OR_PUT AS CALL_PUT_FLAG,T.STRIKE_PRICE*T4.EXCHANGE_RATE AS STRIKE,T.CONTRACT_SIZE AS NOTIONAL,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM, 'CNY' AS MTM_CCY,T.UNDERLYING_CURRENCY_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY,T.BASE_CURRENCY_CODE, T2.FX_RATE/T4.EXCHANGE_RATE AS UNDERLYING_PRICE,T3.MA_ID FROM TB_13_FX_OPTION_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN (SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(T.CURVE_CODE,'_FXCURVE',''),'_','/') AS CURRENCY_PAIR,T.FX_RATE FROM TB_19_FX_CURVE T WHERE T.TERM_CODE='ON' AND T.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}) T2 ON T.CURRENCY_PAIR=T2.CURRENCY_PAIR LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T3 ON T3.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T3.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN V_MRM_SPOT_RATE T4 ON T4.CURRENCY_CODE = T.BASE_CURRENCY_CODE AND T4.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.SETTLE_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE, '货币互换' AS TRADE_TYPE,T.MATURITY_DATE AS END_DATE,CURRENCY_PAIR AS HEDGING_SET, T.PAY_NOTIONAL AS SHORTNOTIONAL,T.PAY_CURRENCY_CODE AS SHORTNOTIONALCURRENCY, T.REC_CURRENCY_CODE AS LONGNOTIONALCURRENCY,T.REC_NOTIONAL AS LONGNOTIONAL,T.REC_NOTIONAL AS NOTIONAL, T.REC_CURRENCY_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM,'CNY' AS MTM_CCY, NULL AS STRIKE_PRICE, NULL AS UNDERLYING_PRICE, T2.MA_ID FROM TB_13_CCS_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T2 ON T2.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.SWAP_TYPE = 'CCS' AND T.MATURITY_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE, '利率互换' AS TRADE_TYPE,T.MATURITY_DATE AS END_DATE,T.PAY_CURRENCY_CODE AS HEDGING_SET, T.PAY_NOTIONAL AS NOTIONAL,T.PAY_CURRENCY_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM, 'CNY' AS MTM_CCY,CASE WHEN T.PAY_INTEREST_TYPE IN ('float','Float','FLOAT','Floating') THEN 'S' WHEN T.REC_INTEREST_TYPE IN ('float','Float','FLOAT','Floating') THEN 'B' END AS POSITION, NULL AS STRIKE_PRICE, NULL AS UNDERLYING_PRICE,T2.MA_ID FROM TB_13_CCS_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T2 ON T2.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.SWAP_TYPE = 'IRS' AND T.MATURITY_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE,T.MATURITY_DATE AS END_DATE, '利率上下限期权' AS TRADE_TYPE,T.STRIKE_RATE AS STRIKE_PRICE,T.NOTIONAL,T.CURRENCY_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY, T.CURRENCY_CODE AS HEDGING_SET,T.BUY_OR_SELL AS POSITION,T.CAP_OR_FLOOR AS CALL_PUT_FLAG,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM, 'CNY' AS MTM_CCY,T2.YIELD_RATE AS UNDERLYING_PRICE,T3.MA_ID FROM TB_13_CAP_FLOOR_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_19_IR_CURVE T2 ON T2.CURVE_CODE=T.FIXING_CURVE AND T2.TERM_CODE=T.FIXING_FREQ AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T3 ON T3.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T3.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.MATURITY_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE, T.MATURITY_DATE AS END_DATE,'利率互换期权' AS TRADE_TYPE,T.CURRENCY_CODE AS HEDGING_SET,T.NOTIONAL,T.CURRENCY_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY, T.CALL_OR_PUT AS CALL_PUT_FLAG,T.BUY_OR_SELL AS POSITION,T.UNDERLYING_START_DATE AS UNDERLYING_EFFECTIV_DATE, T.UNDERLYING_MATURITY_DATE,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM,'CNY' AS MTM_CCY,T.FIXED_RATE AS STRIKE_PRICE, T2.YIELD_RATE AS UNDERLYING_PRICE,T3.MA_ID FROM TB_13_SWAPTION_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_19_IR_CURVE T2 ON T2.CURVE_CODE = T.FIXING_CURVE AND T2.TERM_CODE = T.FIXING_FREQ AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T3 ON T3.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T3.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.MATURITY_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT DISTINCT T.UNDERLYING_CODE AS COMM_CODE,T.COMM_PRICE*T1.EXCHANGE_RATE AS COMM_UNIT_PRICE FROM TB_19_COMM_CURVE T LEFT JOIN V_MRM_SPOT_RATE T1 ON T1.CURRENCY_CODE=T.BASE_CURRENCY_CODE AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.TERM_CODE='0D'

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME, T.BUY_OR_SELL AS POSITION,T.SETTLE_DATE AS END_DATE,T.POSITION AS NOTIONAL,T.UNDERLYING_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY, 'Metals' AS HEDGING_SET, 'Metals' AS SUBCLASS,'商品远期' AS TRADE_TYPE,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM,'CNY' AS MTM_CCY, NULL AS STRIKE_PRICE, NULL AS UNDERLYING_PRICE,T.STRIKE_PRICE*T2.EXCHANGE_RATE AS COMM_PRICE, T3.MA_ID FROM TB_13_COMM_FORWARD_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN V_MRM_SPOT_RATE T2 ON T2.CURRENCY_CODE=T.STRIKE_CURRENCY_CODE AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T3 ON T3.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T3.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.SETTLE_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,'商品掉期' AS TRADE_TYPE,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE, T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME,T.BUY_OR_SELL AS POSITION,T.POSITION AS NOTIONAL,T.FWD_SETTLE_DATE AS END_DATE, T.UNDERLYING_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY,'Energy' AS HEDGING_SET, 'Metals' AS SUBCLASS,T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM,'CNY' AS MTM_CCY, NULL AS STRIKE_PRICE, NULL AS UNDERLYING_PRICE,T.FWD_STRIKE*T2.EXCHANGE_RATE AS COMM_PRICE,T3.MA_ID FROM TB_13_COMM_SWAP_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN V_MRM_SPOT_RATE T2 ON T2.CURRENCY_CODE=T.STRIKE_CURRENCY_CODE AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T3 ON T3.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T3.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.FWD_SETTLE_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.INSTRUMENT_ID AS DEALID,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE,T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AS COUNTERPARTY_NAME, T.BUY_OR_SELL AS POSITION,T.CALL_OR_PUT AS CALL_PUT_FLAG,T.TRADE_DATE AS START_DATE,T.SETTLE_DATE AS END_DATE, '商品期权' AS TRADE_TYPE,'Metals' AS HEDGING_SET, 'Metals' AS SUBCLASS, T.UNDERLYING_CODE AS NOTIONAL_CCY,T.POSITION AS NOTIONAL, T.STRIKE_PRICE*T3.EXCHANGE_RATE AS STRIKE_PRICE,T.STRIKE_PRICE*T3.EXCHANGE_RATE AS COMM_PRICE, T1.NPV_CNY AS MTM,'CNY' AS MTM_CCY,T2.COMM_PRICE*T4.EXCHANGE_RATE,T5.MA_ID FROM TB_13_COMM_OPTION_ALL T LEFT JOIN TB_26_TRADE_MEASURE T1 ON T.INSTRUMENT_ID=T1.INSTRUMENT_ID AND T1.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_19_COMM_CURVE T2 ON T.PRICE_CURVE=T2.CURVE_CODE AND T2.TERM_CODE = '0D' AND T2.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN V_MRM_SPOT_RATE T3 ON T3.CURRENCY_CODE=T.STRIKE_CURRENCY_CODE AND T3.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN V_MRM_SPOT_RATE T4 ON T4.CURRENCY_CODE=T2.BASE_CURRENCY_CODE AND T4.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} LEFT JOIN TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T5 ON T5.COUNTERPARTY_CODE=T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE AND T5.DATA_DATE=#{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE T.SETTLE_DATE > #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT T.MA_ID, T.MA_TYPE, T.COUNTERPARTY_CODE, T.CSA_ID, T.CSA_MPOR, T.CSA_MTA, T.CSA_MTA_CCY, T.CSA_TH, T.CSA_TH_CCY, T.CSA_NICA, T.CSA_NICA_CCY, 'CNY' AS CSA_SETTLEMENT_CCY_x, 0 AS COL_HAIRCUT_x, T.CSA_COLLATERAL, T.CSA_COLLATERAL_CCY FROM TB_17_SACCR_MA_CSA T WHERE T.DATA_DATE = #{dataDate,jdbcType=DATE}
